description: A small synthetic company knowledge base (employee handbook, engineering practices, product FAQ) used to evaluate the retrieval and generation pipelines end to end. Queries are hand-crafted to cover single-chunk lookups, multi-chunk answers, cross-document topical discrimination (e.g. two different kinds of "PTO"), a PDF with real (not estimated) page numbers, and one deliberately out-of-corpus question.

queries.query: How many days of PTO do full-time employees accrue each year?
queries.reference_answer: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of PTO per year, at a rate of 1.25 days per completed month, though accrual doesn't begin until after the 90-day probationary period.

queries.query: Can unused PTO be carried over to the next year, and if so how much?

relevant_chunks.content_marker: carries over into the following year up to a maximum of 5 days

queries.reference_answer: Yes, up to 5 days of unused PTO carry over into the next year; any balance beyond that is forfeited on December 31st unless local law requires otherwise.

queries.query: How many days per week can an employee work remotely without needing special approval?

relevant_chunks.content_marker: up to 3 days per week without prior approval

queries.reference_answer: Up to 3 days per week, as long as the team's core collaboration hours (10 AM to 3 PM) are maintained.

queries.query: What is the daily cap on meal expenses while traveling for business?
queries.reference_answer: 75 dollars per day, inclusive of tips.

queries.query: Above what dollar amount does a business expense require an itemized receipt?
queries.reference_answer: Any single expense over 25 dollars requires an original itemized receipt.

queries.query: Does the company reimburse alcohol at client dinners?

relevant_chunks.content_marker: reimbursable only when directly related to client entertainment

queries.reference_answer: Yes, but only when directly related to client entertainment, and it must be itemized separately from the meal cost.

queries.query: How quickly are harassment reports investigated?
queries.reference_answer: Within 10 business days.

queries.query: How many approvals does a pull request touching billing code need?
queries.reference_answer: Two approvals, at least one from a senior engineer.

queries.query: What's the recommended maximum size for a single pull request?
queries.reference_answer: Under 400 changed lines where practical; larger changes should be split into a stacked series of smaller pull requests.

queries.query: How long must a new deployment's health check stay healthy before the deployment is considered complete?
queries.reference_answer: 5 consecutive minutes; otherwise the pipeline automatically rolls back.

queries.query: When are production deployments automatically paused during the week?
queries.reference_answer: Between 4:00 PM Friday and 8:00 AM Monday, except for emergency hotfixes signed off by the on-call engineering lead.

queries.query: How quickly must the on-call engineer acknowledge a page during business hours?
queries.reference_answer: Within 15 minutes during business hours (30 minutes outside business hours).

queries.query: Do on-call engineers get any extra time off for carrying the pager?
queries.notes: Both this section and the Employee Handbook's PTO section mention 'PTO' — this query tests whether retrieval finds the specific on-call compensation chunk rather than the general PTO-accrual chunk just because both mention the same term.

relevant_chunks.content_marker: compensated with an additional day of PTO

queries.reference_answer: Yes — each on-call week earns an additional day of PTO, credited the following month.

queries.query: What is the full escalation and postmortem process for a Severity 1 incident?

relevant_chunks.content_marker: page the engineering lead within 5 minutes

queries.reference_answer: The on-call engineer must open an incident channel and page the engineering lead within 5 minutes of detection. A written, blameless postmortem covering the timeline, root cause, customer impact, and follow-up action items is required within 5 business days of resolution.

queries.query: If my payment fails, what happens before my account actually gets downgraded?
queries.reference_answer: Three automatic retry attempts over 7 days, spaced 48 hours apart, before the account is downgraded to the free tier.

queries.query: How many team members can the Professional plan have?
queries.reference_answer: Up to 25 team members.

queries.query: How long does a new account owner have to accept an ownership transfer before it expires?
queries.reference_answer: 7 days from when the transfer is initiated.

queries.query: What is the API rate limit for the Professional plan?
queries.notes: Answerable only from page 3 of product_faq.pdf — exercises exact (not estimated) PDF page numbers.
queries.reference_answer: 600 requests per minute.

queries.query: What HTTP status and header does the API return when a rate limit is exceeded?
queries.reference_answer: HTTP 429, with a Retry-After header indicating how many seconds to wait before retrying.

queries.query: How long is data kept in backups after an account is deleted, and can it be restored during that time?

relevant_chunks.content_marker: retained in encrypted backups for 30 days

queries.reference_answer: Data is retained in encrypted backups for 30 days after deletion. During that window, support can restore an individual document or the entire account on request; after 30 days the backup is permanently purged and recovery is no longer possible.

queries.query: What is the company's policy on parental leave?
queries.notes: Deliberately unanswerable from this corpus — used to check that the system declines rather than fabricates an answer.
